summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn after BarColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now uses finished_time; _reset clears it; capture rule added at end of update and advance inside the lock); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with two Added entries, one for TimeElapsedColumn and one for Palette.__rich__); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn; expected string regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads: elapsed 0:00:37/0:00:36 in start frames, 0:01:00/0:00:45 in finished frames, bar widths 25 and 16, speed 1 byte/s); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Nothing was committed. Tests were NOT run because the instructions prohibited running repository code; the test_columns expected output is derived by hand trace and is unverified until pytest runs. Ambiguity resolved: reset with completed equal to total clears the finished time (per the explicit reset rule) but never captures.
